axis.description: int or sequence of ints, default=None. Axis along which the sum to be computed. If None, the sum is computed along all the axes.

b.description: scaling factors for the exponentials. Must be broadcastable to the shape of `a`.

keepdims.description: If ``True``, the axes that are reduced are left in the output as dimensions of size 1.

return_sign.description: If ``True``, the output will be a ``(result, sign)`` pair, where ``sign`` is the sign of the sums and ``result`` contains the logarithms of their absolute values. If ``False`` only ``result`` is returned and it will contain NaN values if the sums are negative.
constraints: return_sign must be one of True, sign, False

where.description: Elements to include in the reduction.

output.description: Either an array ``result`` or a pair of arrays ``(result, sign)``, depending on the value of the ``return_sign`` argument.
